The '''Hsuberry tree''' was a [[Tree/Legends|tree]] native to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] well known for its [[Hsuberry|berries]]. The berries were fermented by [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] to produce [[Hsuberry elixir]], which was known for its life-giving properties.
